description: This Java class 'NonEmptyValueValidator' is a final, immutable class that extends 'AbstractHeaderValueValidator'. It verifies that header values are non-empty, throwing a 'DittoHeaderInvalidException' if a value is empty. The class follows the singleton pattern with a private constructor and a static accessor method.

classes.name: NonEmptyValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that ensures header values are not empty.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Checks if the provided header value is non-empty; throws exception if empty.
